blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Senior citizens rights advocate and lawyer Romulo Macalintal on Thursday said that the mandatory 20-percent discount for senior citizens could only be waived if an establishment’s promotional price is approved by the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI). Macalintal stressed this in calling for a clarification of the recent Supreme Court ruling on a case of the hotel manager who was acquitted of violating Republic Act No. 7432, or the Senior Citizens Act. The high tribunal ruled that the two seniors, who filed the complaint against the hotel manager, were entitled to only one type of discount when availing goods […]...
